Learn More See More See Less Every year, each weekend, a lucky car wins VIP For Life. Fill your car with a crew of 4 or more and this could be you! Vehicles must be decorated with CARPOOLCHELLA® for a chance to win. Refresh your fit and your mindset at the 2026 Art Studios. From upcycled Learn More See More See Less fashion to bead bars and DIY jewelry, everything you need to level up your look is here - and it’s all free. Blend your own aromatherapy oil to roll on, wear out, and take home. Every craft is a hands-on experience, made by you, for you. If you make it, you take it. Check back closer to festival dates for more details. Check out this cute video from 2025. Take a trip through Coachella eras with BELLA+CANVAS, the festival's official blanks provider. See More See Less Relive Coachella's greatest moments and merchandise, then remix the past your way—choose your BELLA+CANVAS blank, pick your vintage Coachella design from the archives, and walk away with your one-of-a-kind custom Coachella merchandise. Take home a custom creation to remember the best weekend ever. Welcome to a mini-sized Coachella, Miniverse style. See More See Less From the ferris wheel to the desert palm trees, every detail comes to life at Miniverse scale. Take a photo, grab a mocktail from the mini bar, relax in the lounge, and slip into a mini escape as nostalgic tunes spin on the tiniest working vinyl records. Big energy. Tiny details. A festival experience scaled unlike anything else. The main store will include brand new Coachella 2026 merchandise, featuring See More See Less Weekend 1 and Weekend 2 exclusives, limited-edition collaborations with Gap, SUAY, Ian Charms, Plushie Love and Barbie, and an exclusive GV Black Coachella collection featuring Honor The Gift and more! Introducing SUAY x Coachella, a circular fully upcycled collection of one-of-a-kind Coachella apparel. Made from vintage Coachella merchandise, recycled garments and reclaimed fabrics, each piece is one-of-one and tells a story of its own. Made locally, ethically and sustainably in Los Angeles. Stop by the Coachella Merchandise: Then and Now activation powered by BELLA+CANVAS, located East of the Coachella Store. Explore iconic merchandise from 25 years of Coachella, and create your own Coachella merchandise with vintage graphics from the archive. Come recharge, create, and cool down at the Gap Hoodie House. Shop limited-edition Gap x Coachella hoodies and turn them into one-of-a-kind pieces with custom patches, beads, and charms that change each day! (located next to the Headliner Merchandise Tents, South of the Main Entrance, North of Sahara Tent) Visit the Coachella VIP Store, located in the 12 Peaks VIP area, to shop select Coachella festival merchandise and limited-edition VIP-exclusive items, while supplies last. Head over to Camping to shop vintage merchandise and select items from the Coachella 2026 Collection. The annual vintage merchandise sale will be open Thursday only (April 9th and 16th) starting at 6 PM. 2026 merchandise will be available at the Coachella Festival Store in Camping on show days from 10am-3pm. No artist merchandise or exclusives will be available in this area. Shop Coachella Artist Merchandise, featuring Coachella-exclusive artist swag, stocked with limited-edition goods you won’t want to miss! (located east of the Coachella Store). Find the Headliner Merchandise Tents (Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber, Anyma, Karol G) to shop Coachella-exclusive artist swag, stocked with limited-edition goods you won’t want to miss (located South of the Main Entrance, North of Sahara Tent). SKYLRK apparel will also be available at the SKYLRK activation, located near the Indio Central Market & Heineken House. Saturdays 4/11 & 4/18 8:30am meet. 9:00am Run Start See More See Less After a massive double weekend success last year, the Coachella run club sponsored by Electrolit is returning for year two! We're hitting the desert road for more than just the miles. We're running for the moments. In the heart of Coachella, where the music and nature meet, we're bringing back the ultimate community of unity, positivity, and movement. This isn't just a run; It's a rhythm of love and unforgettable memories. Let's Move! Step into the charming world of Coca's Pop Shop – a vibrant sound-driven space, where See More See Less frizzing bubbles, modern design, and immersive storytelling create the perfect place to refresh, connect, and experience Real Magic. Dive into adrenaline-pumping dodgeball tournaments, get lost in massive bubble parties, and team up for relay races to meet your new festival squad and keep your eyes on the prize, because top competitors can score VIP upgrades. Grab your friends, print it on the spot, and leave with the most unique souvenir of the weekend. GV Black’s Party In My Living Room activation and Merch Collaboration at Coachella Learn More See More See Less is a commitment and opportunity for Black, Indigenous, and People of Color (BIPOC) to be seen at the festival. We actively promote diversity to change the narrative of what it means to be at Coachella. This year, it’s all about the people you’re with. Explore the lineup bringing fans together at Coachella. 21+ Learn More GA & Charging Lockers for rent. Store your gear with unlimited access show days. Learn More Locked out of your car? Lost your keys? No problem! See More See Less Call Wes, our onsite Locksmith: (760) 835-4427 Thursday-Sunday, 24 hours Pro Tip: Be sure to check with Lost & Found before calling the locksmith. We find dozens of keys each year and we are confused how people don’t come over to grab them from Lost & Found! Discover the earplugs made for festivals. See More See Less Our official festival earplugs keep music clear while protecting your ears in style. Find them at any Loop booth on the festival grounds. Search for your lost items & turn in what you found. Check back on show dates. Learn More Don’t miss your moment with Medicube! See More See Less Refresh your glow with Medicube favorites on-site so you leave feeling stage-ready and radiant. Visit our 8 dispensers located throughout festival grounds to reapply your sunscreen with Superior broad-spectrum protection that you will love. Returning to the desert is Inglewood's very own, Party In My Room! PIMLR and GV Black See More See Less are teaming up to bring the best house party to the desert both weekends. You never know who will come through! USB and AC charging stations located in the camping center & around the venue. See More See Less Keep your phone charged. BYOC (Bring Your Own Cable) Outlets are AC (2-prong North American) and USB (at most locations). Power cubes are for charging mobile phones only. Do not charge external battery packs or attempt to power hair dryers, curling irons, air pumps or any other electronic devices. Test your environmental knowledge for a chance to win a Polar Bear’s heart! See More See Less Compete to “win the heart” of Ursus the Polar Bear by demonstrating your knowledge about environmental challenges and sustainability. Melt his heart and win cool prizes! Saturdays at 1:00PM at the Desert Sky tent. Team Q+ unites to celebrate and honor the Queer+ BIPOC community. Learn More A 75-minute large-format film and art installation. Limited Viewings Fri-Sun. Reservations full, stand by only. See More See Less Made from thousands of fragments created by Thom Yorke and Stanley Donwood during the recording of Kid A and Amnesiac: sketches, paintings, collages, audio recordings, and handwritten notes. 5 screenings a day Air conditioned No ins/outs The Bunker, located near Sahara Doors & Reservations Door times are 30 minutes prior to screening Reservations will be held for 20 minutes after the door time, then released to standby guests Reservations will be prioritized but entry not guaranteed if arriving after the 20 minute grace period. There will be a separate reservation queue that will by pass the standby queue for late arriving reservation holders. Once the bunker is at capacity, we will grant access on a one in/one out basis. Reservation holders for that showing will have priority, and then the standby line. Rules/Regulations No food or alcoholic beverages allowed inside All patrons must exit the space immediately after the screening has finished All patrons must exit through the south exit Respect the exhibit and art pieces No smoking No bathrooms inside the venue Photography and filming is prohibited in the venue (no spoilers) Respect and be mindful of other patrons viewing experience ADA Accessible venue Elevator available Ask a team member for assistance There is not a separate ada entrance Standby queue Reservations are encouraged, but a standby queue will be available Standby does not guarantee entrance into the venue Wait times may be long Visit Record Safari at the festival and dig into over 25,000 pieces of new and... See More See Less used vintage vinyl while you cool off in our air-conditioned store. Yes, we’ll have some Record Store Day exclusives on Saturday, April 18th. Best of all, we’ll store your purchases until Sunday night for only $12 which also comes with an exclusive Coachella tote! (so that precious plastic doesn’t melt.) A multi-level social destination located across from Quasar stage. Red Bull Mirage serves as a dynamic Learn More See More See Less hospitality space that provides something for everyone. Happy Hours at Red Bull Mirage Club Open to all festivalgoers, Mirage Club on the ground level of Red Bull Mirage will serve complimentary specialty Red Bull mocktails and the crowd-favorite Red Bull Summer Slushies starting at 3 PM daily (while supplies last). Beverages will be served in keepsake aluminum color-changing cups for festival goers to take home. Red Bull Mirage Hours Red Bull Mirage is open to guests on both weekends of Coachella, April 10-12 and April 17-19, between the hours of: Red Bull Mirage Club: 1:00 PM -11:00 PM daily Table Service and Nobu Reservations: 5:00 PM - 11:00 PM Friday/Saturday, 5:00 PM - 10:00 PM Sun Red Bull Mirage Viewing Access multiple levels of Red Bull Mirage via a first-come, first-served early entry basis. Sign up for text alerts to find out how you can enter and real-time updates during the festival. Nobu Omakase at Red Bull Mirage Set within Red Bull Mirage overlooking the Quasar Stage, Nobu at Coachella offers an elevated dining escape inside the festival. Reserve via Dorsia for a curated omakase by Nobu sushi chefs and all-day Floor 1 access to Red Bull Mirage. Red Bull Mirage Club Open to all festivalgoers, the ground-level area of Red Bull Mirage offers shaded seating, misting fans, and a screen viewing of Quasar programming. With a special menu of Red Bull beverages, it’s the place to cool off, recharge, and stay in the flow throughout the day. For more information visit: redbull.com/mirage Join Rivian as they bridge festival energy with natural wonder, letting you recharge your See More See Less spirit with meditative soundscapes and celestial light displays. Discover a desert oasis powered by Rivian electric vehicles, featuring a listening lounge made from sustainable materials and their all-new R2 24-hour emergency response. Location on Map. Learn More Located in Lot 8! Check back closer to festival dates for details The Hideout at Coachella – a special pop-up for Soho House members with VIP passes See More See Less – brings its style to Coachella Valley. A place to relax and hang out day and night, its air-conditioned interior is the perfect spot to refresh and enjoy the festival mood. A short walk from the main stage, enjoy Soho Health Club smoothies and House cocktails, plus a menu that includes sushi and classics such as their House burger, from 1pm to 1am daily. Located in 12 Peaks VIP. Camping Solo? Come adopt a festie bestie? & play games to find friends! See More See Less Coachella is better with a crew, but arriving solo doesn't mean staying solo… We’re hosting a Solo Camper Adoption right into some friend making games. Solo campers lined up and ready for their new festival family. They’ll be holding signs with their "Must-See" artists and their campground vibes. The Mission: Is your group looking for a +1? A dance partner for Justice? A fellow Spicy Pie enthusiast? Swing by the Hub in Lot 8, check the signs, and "adopt" a new friend for the weekend! Step into the spotlight with showstopping festival hair at the Spotlight Hair See More See Less experience by Wavytalk. Get styled by a pro, refresh your look at our self-style stations, play interactive games, win exclusive prizes, and capture it all in the Spotlight Studio photo booth. Turn up the volume and own bold, long-lasting hair all weekend long. The official airline of Coachella is back with an experience you won't want to miss. See More See Less Stop on by for cold drinks, music and more — then sign up for Atmos™ Rewards to unlock exclusive giveaways. Still trip planning? Jet there on Alaska and choose from more flights to Palm Springs (PSP) than any other carrier. Book now at alaskaair.com. After 250+ careers, Barbie is not defined by a single job, look, or label - and neither are you. See More See Less Step into a world that celebrates self-expression, creativity, and showing up as you are. You can be any Barbie. What will you be? Experience live butterflies & shop for fresh produce. See More See Less Flutterby brings a special butterfly encounter, an up-close and personal experience with California’s native butterflies. While you are here, discover a selection of organic produce grown from the very plants pollinated by these incredible creatures, brought to you by Coachella Valley’s own, Aziz Farms. For $20, fans enjoy a 7-minute immersive session. Located near the Food Trucks in Lot 8. Open Thursday: 2pm- 9pm Friday–Sunday: 7am–2pm & 7pm–2am Produce sold separately. Visit Method portals and tap into that vintage sun-soaked, carefree feeling when joy was loud, weird was welcome, and the moment was everything. See More See Less Refresh with method body wash and cryo air, unwind at the salon with method haircare, complete your transformation with free method products., and don't forget to take a boomerang! Located in Lot 8! Long days under the desert sun call for a little high-end recovery. See More See Less Step into The Oasis for the ultimate reset. From the crisp chill of our ice baths and oxygen bar, to the healing glow of red-light therapy, we’ll help you find your second wind. Relax with a soothing massage, then let our team finish your look with fresh hair, makeup, and henna. Before you head to the music, stop by for a piece of permanent jewelry to make those Coachella feels forever. Hours: Thursday: 3pm-9pm Friday-Sunday: 9am-3pm BOOK NOW *times subject to change We’re turning Porta-potties to Porta-Parties! See More See Less Immersive yourself in a dreamy bathroom oasis by refreshing at the glitter bar, enjoying a cool mocktail, and sampling FREE Always Pocket FlexFoam pads and Secret Mocktails deodorant. And did we mention our crowd-favorite VIP bathrooms are returning this year?! Escape into our immersive chill lounge, a canvas of light and sound. See More See Less Sink into a bean bag or kick back on a lounge chair while DJ’s spin vibey sets against stunning projection-mapped visuals that dance across every wall. Located in the Camping center on the hill in Lot 8. Fri-Sun: 8am-3am Kick off the weekend atop Coyote Hill gazing into the cosmos. From high-energy competition to deep restorative zen, the Camping Hub offers a diverse circuit of movement and mindfulness across the Learn More See More See Less Desert Sky, Field of Dreams, and The Oasis. To radiate in the heat, you must first be anchored in the sand. Our wellness programming is designed around the biology of the desert, teaching you how to stay strong, connected, and balanced. Explore our full schedule of yoga, sound baths, and fitness challenges to keep your body fueled and your spirit high all weekend long.
